With the controller open: volume up = A, volume down = B trigger. Play with your phone’s physical buttons

Keep pressed when leaving the button

For games that ask for a Nunchuk (Mario Galaxy, Zelda…): your Wii Remote carries one and the controller turns sideways by itself, with the stick, C and Z under your left hand. Off, sideways is the NES pad. Dolphin must be reopened after changing it. Remembered

Which way the sideways Dolphin controller with Nunchuk turns (Left = the camera edge ends up on the left). Asked the first time and then fixed: some phones\' sensors flip it on their own
Is the controller the right way up?

Which way the Wii U GamePad (and Pro Controller) turns, separately from the Wii Remote + Nunchuk. Asked the first time and then fixed
Is the GamePad the right way up?

Checks versions and release notes on GitHub at startup and hourly while you use the app. No personal identifiers.
A new version is available. Would you like to install it?
Android will ask you to confirm installation. The app will close when updated; settings and pairings are preserved.
Android needs permission to install updates from PepoMote. Enable it and come back here. If you cancel, you can try again whenever you like.
Android has opened the installer. If you cancelled or installation did not finish, you can try again.
Download cancelled. You can restart it whenever you like.
The download could not finish. Check your connection and available storage, then try again.
The download does not match a valid update for this app. Nothing has been installed. You can download it again.
Android could not open the installer. You can try again.
You have the latest available version.
Could not check the latest version. The release may not be ready yet. You can retry; automatic checking will also try again.
Check the latest version whenever you like.

What the phone moves the cursor with. Gyroscope: you aim and the cursor goes where you point. Accelerometer and derived: you tilt the phone sideways and up or down, for phones without a real gyroscope
Your phone has a real gyroscope (%1$s)
Your phone has no real gyroscope: it exposes a similar one (%1$s), derived from the accelerometer, which may drift, lag or behave inconsistently. Accelerometer is recommended for this phone
Your phone has no gyroscope: the pointer can only work by tilting (accelerometer)
Your phone has no real gyroscope

It has a similar sensor, derived from the accelerometer, which is not guaranteed to be free of drift, lag or inconsistencies. PepoMote will use the accelerometer: tilt the phone sideways and up or down to move the cursor. The sensor is chosen in Settings
PepoMote will use the accelerometer: tilt the phone sideways and up or down to move the cursor. The sensor is chosen in Settings

You chose its similar sensor (derived from the accelerometer): it may drift, lag or behave inconsistently, and on many phones the cursor only moves up and down. If it does not work well, choose Accelerometer in Settings
Pointing by tilting (accelerometer) needs PepoMote updated on the PC. With this receiver the cursor may only move vertically
Your phone, your PC\'s controller in 3 steps
Open PepoMote on your PC, or tap Server on the Android where you will run Dolphin, Eden or RetroArch.
On the controller phone: Connect → scan the receiver QR code. Use the same Wi-Fi on both devices.
With a gyroscope, point like a Wii Remote. Without a real one, the pointer works by tilting (the app tells you); and you can always play with buttons, sticks and touch controls.
Turn the phone to go back to the upright controller
For Wii U games played with the Wii Remote (Wii Sports Club, Wii Party U…)
On Wii U the Nunchuk only works if the controller picks Wii Remote
No screen (the PC is not sending it)
For the game\'s on-screen keyboard. Delete removes a character in Cemu, Type sends the text and continues, Accept sends the text and Enter.
The text goes wherever the PC caret is. Send pastes it as is; Send + ⏎ types it and presses Enter (search, go to an address); Delete removes one character.
The text goes to whichever window has focus on the PC: the game, the browser… Send pastes it as is; Send + ⏎ types it and presses Enter (search); Delete removes one character.
The Keyboard button first left-clicks where you are pointing, to put the caret in the field. When off, click with A yourself before typing.
Keep your Switch controller this way?
Update the PC receiver to use Switch.
For the game\'s on-screen keyboard. Delete removes a character, Type sends the text and continues, Accept sends the text and Enter.
Each console\'s pad, Wii Remote or light gun
Each console\'s pad or the Wii Remote Remote
Update PepoMote on the receiver (PC or server phone) to use RetroArch.
Update PepoMote on the PC to use the universal controller.
Console: the pad of the game RetroArch loads (tap it to pick another) · Wii Remote: portrait or landscape, aim on PC; B and A · Light gun: aim with the phone, B fires and A reloads

Types into the RetroArch window (bring it to the front; with a keyboard in the game, enable game focus). Delete removes a character, Type sends the text and continues, Accept sends the text and Enter.
Rewind is held down; the rest are a tap
Enter the code shown on the other phone’s Server screen. You can also scan its QR code.
This phone runs Dolphin, Eden or RetroArch. Another phone with PepoMote becomes your controller.
Stays active while you play. Stop the server when you finish.
Cannot start: another app is using the connection port. Close it or change its port, then try again.
The server could not start. Check the network connection and try again.
Ready for controllers while you play in Dolphin, Eden or RetroArch.
Use the same Wi-Fi or this phone’s hotspot. On the controller: Connect → Scan QR, or Connect with code → choose this server and enter the 4 digits.
QR code to connect another phone to this Android server
Connect this phone to Wi-Fi or enable its hotspot to show the pairing QR code.
Waiting for the first controller… Up to 4 players.
An emulator is requesting controller input.
The emulator has not requested controller input yet.
PepoMote maps the buttons and saves a copy of your previous controls. Setup is needed only the first time or when changing controllers.
Official Dolphin · Wii Remote, buttons, motion and Nunchuk on the same phone.
Eden · Pro Controller with buttons and both sticks.
Motion in Eden: current versions mix the controller’s gyroscope with the server phone’s sensors. This can interfere with remote motion. Buttons and sticks do not depend on those sensors.
Saving the backup and checking settings…
Install the current official version of %1$s and open it once before setting up its controls.
The emulator could not be found. Install it and open it once before continuing.
The settings PepoMote changed in %1$s will be restored. Changes you made afterward will be kept. You will then need to fully stop the emulator and open it again.
%1$s controls saved and verified. Finish the last step to start playing.
The setup could not be completed. %1$s
The Android file picker could not be found. Enable the system Files app and try again.
For %1$s to read the new controls, open its app information and tap Force stop. Then return here and open it. Swiping it away from recent apps may not be enough. Do this without a game running.
Open Android Settings → Apps → the emulator → Force stop. Then return to PepoMote.

If you add players or change the Nunchuk, set up controls again with those controllers connected and restart the emulator. Player 1 can switch between Dolphin, Eden and RetroArch from their controller.
%1$d changes you made after the backup were preserved.
The code is incorrect or has changed. Tap Connect with code, choose the PC or phone and enter its current code. You can also scan its QR.
I have force stopped it: open
Cannot access the emulator folder. Close the emulator and select its folder again. Saved backups are retained.
Choose the emulator’s own folder. In the Android picker sidebar, tap Dolphin or Eden, then Use this folder. Do not select Android/data or another folder.
Read and write permission is missing. Select the emulator folder again and allow access so controls can be saved and restored.
Open the emulator once so it creates its settings. Close any game and set up the controls again.
The settings changed or belong to another emulator installation. Close the emulator and check the selected folder before continuing.
The controller backup could not be saved or read. Check the phone’s free storage. Keep this PepoMote installation to retain existing backups.
The controls could not be applied. Changes from this attempt were rolled back. Fully stop the emulator before trying again.

Setup was interrupted or detected external changes. The backup and files requiring review were retained. Close the emulator and try restoring controls. If the error continues, keep this installation and check the details.
No controller backup is available to restore.
Start the server before opening the emulator from PepoMote.
The players or Nunchuk have changed. Update the controls before opening your game.
The %1$s variant you set up is missing. Reinstall or enable that same variant to keep and recover its controls.
Leave any game before continuing. Android will open the access screen for %1$s.
1. Tap “Use this folder”.\n2. Tap “Allow”.\n3. Return here: PepoMote sets up the controls.
If Android shows a different location, open the side menu and tap %1$s. Stay out of its subfolders.
Access is saved; you will not need to choose a folder again.
Next time, connect the controller and tap Play.
Android needs you to close %1$s to load its new controls. Leave your game first.
1. In its app info, tap “Force stop” and confirm.\n2. Use Back to return to PepoMote.\n3. Tap “I have closed it: play”.
Open %1$s and finish its welcome screens. Then come back here and tap Continue. You do not need to open a game.
Choose a private network that lets both phones communicate. A commercial browsing VPN usually cannot do this.
You need a WireGuard network already configured to connect both phones. Import each phone’s own configuration and activate its tunnel. Installing the app alone does not create that network.
Install Tailscale on both phones, add them to the same private network and turn on the connection on both.
Then come back here, tap “Use VPN connection” and share the link. On the controller phone: Connect → Enter link.
Response time depends on distance and connection quality. Only controls are sent; the game picture stays on the server. Automatic discovery searches the local network only.
No compatible VPN connection has been detected on this phone yet.
The VPN has disconnected. Turn it on to show the link for that network again.
On the other phone: Connect → Enter link.
Could not open sharing. You can scan the QR with the other phone instead.
Connect both devices to the same Wi-Fi and open PepoMote on the PC, or tap Server on the other Android. Then choose it here.
No devices found yet. Check that PepoMote is open and the server is running. You can also scan its QR.
Enter the 4-digit code shown next to the QR in PepoMote on your PC.
Enter the 4-digit code shown in Server on the other Android. If that phone has an older version, its 6-digit code also works.
Received a link from another Android? Paste it here. On the same Wi-Fi, you can simply use the QR or code.

The Android server creates this link. It contains the connection details for your controller; you do not need to find it on a website.

1. On the other Android, open PepoMote and tap Server.
2. Tap Copy link and send it to this phone.
3. Paste it here and tap Connect.

For different networks, first activate the VPN on both phones. On the server, open “On different networks?” and tap “Use VPN connection” before copying the link.
This Android server offers Dolphin, Eden and RetroArch
Only Player 1 can change the server mode
This Android server does not accept text
This Android server does not stream its screen
The light gun needs the PC receiver: you keep your RetroArch pad
An emulator asked for the controllers: %1$s mode
If buttons do not work, check that “Network RetroPad” and each controller\'s user are enabled in RetroArch.
RetroArch · Each console\'s pad (NES, SNES, Mega Drive, N64, PlayStation…), the Wii Remote Remote and hotkeys. No light gun on Android.
Install RetroArch (retroarch.com or Google Play) and open it once.
RetroArch was not found. Install it and open it once before continuing.
Enable the network gamepad in RetroArch (once)
Android does not let PepoMote touch RetroArch\'s settings, so you flip these switches in its menu. PepoMote checks and remembers the command connection; the network gamepad is enabled separately.

1. Open RetroArch → Settings → User Interface → enable “Show Advanced Settings”.
2. Settings → Network → enable “Network Commands” (port 55355).
3. Below it, enable “Network RetroPad” (base port 55400) and user 1. For more controllers, also users 2, 3 and 4.
4. Main Menu → Configuration File → Save Current Configuration. Then quit RetroArch, come back here and tap “Open RetroArch”.
Waiting for RetroArch to answer… It only answers while it is in front: open it, give it a few seconds and come back; PepoMote remembers.
RetroArch %1$s is answering · %2$d polls per second
RetroArch %1$s already answered. It only answers while it is in front: open it and play.
Controllers are in RetroArch but it does not answer network commands: the pad is sent blind at 60 Hz. Enable “Network Commands” in RetroArch.
Each phone is one player: player 1 uses port 55400, player 2 55401… Enable as many network RetroPad “User N” entries in RetroArch as phones.

RetroArch notes in its RetroArch folder which game it just loaded. With permission to read it, the phone shows that console\'s pad. Without it, the full RetroPad (the console can be picked by hand on the phone).
playlists/builtin/content_history.lpl is not in that folder. Choose the RetroArch folder in the phone\'s storage (RetroArch creates it when it has all-files access).
Android did not grant read access. Choose the folder again.
RetroArch\'s history has no game yet.
Android\'s folder picker will open at the RetroArch folder in the phone\'s storage. PepoMote only reads it.
1. Tap “Use this folder”.\n2. Tap “Allow”.\n3. Return here: the phone will show each console\'s pad.
If Android shows another location, open the side menu, tap this phone and enter RetroArch.
This link is invalid. Copy the complete link from the server.
When the game asks for it (Mario Party, Wii Sports…), your phone rumbles. The tap feedback on buttons is separate and unchanged.
The connected PC can rumble your phone.
The PC does not have the rumble virtual controller yet (see the receiver window).
The receiver has no /dev/uinput permission: no rumble (see its window).
This receiver cannot send rumble (macOS or Android server).
The receiver is older than 1.12: no game rumble.
This device has no vibration motor.
Turning the phone moves the right stick and the game reacts: in The Binding of Isaac you shoot wherever you move it, and in Until Dawn you have to hold it still. You can change this in Settings.
Universal controller only: turning the phone moves the right stick. The on-screen right stick always wins over the gyro.
